args.data:
Risk Review Coordinator Note

Two workstreams have been delegated for this risk review:

1. var-analyst: Analyzing VaR exposure trends for the Flagship Long/Short fund (YTD). The VaR Trend widget (risk_exposure_monitor_dashboard_var_trend) from Bench Stark Enterprise has been added to the Overview tab to provide underlying risk data. Current VaR for Flagship Long/Short is -222500 USD with a change of -0.0302.

2. stress-analyst: Performing stress testing analysis for the Flagship Long/Short fund. This workstream will leverage stress loss and scenario data to assess portfolio resilience.

Both workstreams now have access to the VaR Trend widget data on the Delegation Board Overview tab.
